idea: A coachbuilt car at night: one deep midnight-blue lacquer, each side panel picked out by a single thin gold coachline, and a few gold stars on the nose like the first ones out.
world: Hand-finished coachbuilding (the gold pinstripe a coachbuilder lays round a grand tourer's panels) under a clear night sky.

signature.says: The gold coachline: one thin, even gold line traced just inside a side panel's own edge, following the panel's creases and the body's edges exactly. It starts at the panel's front corner, runs closed round the whole panel, and ends where it began: never cut short, never doubled, never leaving the panel's edge to make a shape of its own.

dna.says: Every mark is gold on blue, thin and exact, taken from the panel it sits on. One line width for every coachline, 0.5 cm, whatever the panel's size: the same hand everywhere. Corners follow the car's own corners, never added. Stars: five points, sharp, inner radius 0.45, upright; 3 to 6 cm across, each a different size, set loosely like real stars, never in a row or a grid. A sparse rhythm: a few, with dark between.

colours.name: midnight blue
colours.job: the car: the whole body and the inner car, one lacquer, the night itself; the car's own lights glow in it, low

colours.name: night black
colours.job: the hardware in the cockpit and under it: the seat, belts, steering wheel and column, dashboard, engine bay, exhausts, driveshafts, brakes, rear dampers and the speed display's backing, so the blue reads as the car

colours.name: gold
colours.job: the accent, rare: the coachlines and the stars, nothing else

meet: Gold meets blue edge to edge, crisp, nothing between. Blue meets night black at the car's own seams, where the blue car ends and the hardware begins; gold never touches black.

surfaces.job: the body: deep gloss lacquer, the blue reads wet
the coachlines and stars: gold leaf, a metal that catches the light
the hardware in the cockpit and under it: satin night black, quiet

ageing: Stays new on purpose: fresh lacquer, polished, gold untouched; no wear and no extra dirt.

large.what: the one midnight-blue body, whole; the coachline round each big side panel

fullness: Nearly empty: a blue car with a gold line round each side panel and a handful of stars on the nose. The quiet blue everywhere else is the design.
never: gold in large areas or stripes across the car
lines that leave a panel's own edge to make shapes of their own
stars anywhere but the nose, or in rows
gradients, fades or a two-tone body
